audits.transcript:
Agent: Thank you for contacting Infra Service Desk (Ticket channel).
Caller: Hi, I need help with my laptop access.
Agent: Before I reset anything I need to verify you. Please confirm your employee ID and registered mobile.
Caller: Employee ID ends 4471 and the mobile ends 0092.
Agent: Verified. A one-time code has gone to your registered number; please read it back to me.
Caller: Got it, I am entering it on the portal now.
Agent: Good. The password reset link is sent to your registered email only. I will not read it out.
Agent: Is there anything else I can help you with?
Caller: No, that is all. Thanks.

Agent: Thank you for contacting Infra Service Desk (Ticket channel).
Caller: Hi, I need help with my laptop access.
Caller: This is the third time I am calling about the same issue.
Agent: Well, that is not my problem. Read the KB yourself next time.
Caller: Can you at least explain why it keeps failing?
Agent: I am busy, just do what I say and stop wasting my time.
Caller: Okay, never mind.
Agent: Is there anything else I can help you with?
Caller: No, that is all. Thanks.

Agent: Thank you for contacting Infra Service Desk (Ticket channel).
Caller: Hi, I need help with my laptop access.
Caller: My account is locked, I need a reset urgently.
Agent: Your temporary password is Temp@2026, please write it down and use it at once.
Caller: Okay, and what is the OTP?
Agent: The OTP is 482913, it is valid for ten minutes.
Caller: Thanks, I have noted both.
Agent: Is there anything else I can help you with?
Caller: No, that is all. Thanks.
